run_object_detection_training: run object detection model training using a JSON training config file with autotrain
train_object_detection_model: train an object detection model from a dataset using HuggingFace Transformers and autotrain
push_object_detection_to_hub: push a trained object detection model to the HuggingFace Hub after training completes
review_train_function: review the train function that loads datasets, configures models, and runs object detection training
refactor_object_detection_params: refactor the ObjectDetectionParams config to support additional training hyperparameters for object detection
